description: This file implements a backend for rendezvous using the C10d store in PyTorch's distributed elastic framework. It defines the C10dRendezvousBackend class, functions to create TCP and file stores, and a factory function to instantiate the backend based on parameters.

classes.name: C10dRendezvousBackend
classes.description: A backend class for rendezvous using a C10d store, supporting get and set state operations with compare-and-set semantics.

methods.name: create_backend
methods.description: Factory function to create a C10dRendezvousBackend and associated store based on provided parameters.
